title: Extradition fight and 'we want to see him fry' embassy meeting

tellings.quote: Ed Gibson, who was a tache to the US embassy in London at the time, met with my lawyer and he said, "We want to see him fry." Electric chair reference.

plain: A British computer hacker, Gary McKinnon, says he broke into US government systems and found signs of a secret NASA space program, and then faced a long fight against extradition, being sent to the US to stand trial, in the 2000s. He says Ed Gibson, an official at the US embassy in London, met his lawyer and said, "We want to see him fry," a reference to the electric chair. He tells it to show how harshly he says the US wanted to punish him.
